title: Landing page for a dental clinic
lead: Services with prices, doctors, patient reviews, a map and an appointment form, in a calm light style.

hero.caption: Nocturne Dental, first screen: a book-your-first-visit form and a phone number.
hero.alt: Nocturne Dental, first screen: a book-your-first-visit form and a phone number.

problem: A small private dental clinic has no site, and appointments are made by phone. It needs a one-page site with services and prices, doctors, reviews, a licence number, an address with a map, opening hours and, above all, an appointment form.
built: A first screen with an appointment form (name, phone, convenient time).
Six services with a from price for each.
Four doctor cards with experience and specialisation.
Patient reviews, address with a map scheme, opening hours and a licence line.
A second appointment form at the bottom of the page.

shots.caption: Four dentists with their specialty and years in practice, then six patient reviews.
shots.alt: Four dentists with their specialty and years in practice, then six patient reviews.

shots.caption: The same Nocturne Dental first screen on a phone.
shots.alt: The same Nocturne Dental first screen on a phone.

steps: The visitor sees the appointment form on the first screen.
Services and prices are listed up front.
Map, hours and a second form close the page.
offer: A one-page clinic site from your texts and photos.
Appointment requests sent to your email and Telegram.
Advice on a domain and hosting.
not_included: Hosting, domain and third-party service fees.
